query_fallback: replace non-alphanumeric characters with spaces, lowercase, retry
common_mode_quality_score_reason: Neutral constant prevents README structure, code size, owners, release history, dependencies, traffic, and other unsupported inputs from changing the shared-field comparison.
shared_metadata_mode: name, keywords, and description only; README is omitted unless a separately frozen README snapshot is added for every Cargo document.
query_subset: Only primary Cargo queries whose intended evidence is name, keywords, or description; advisory, alias, dependency, yank, version, forge, and non-Cargo queries are excluded.
execution_status: The projection is exported offline. run_common_lane.py executes pinned search_index::CrateSearchIndex.search in common-field mode and the Nudox production adapter after an authorized build slot; this contract contains no ranking or latency results.
ranking_source_status: ranking/src/lib_ranking.rs is pinned and hash-checked for context but is not linked or executed by the standalone adapter
upstream_checkout_requirement: exact pinned revision and a clean worktree, including untracked files; path dependency categories is built from that checked-out revision
query_limit: run_common_lane.py --limit value, recorded in the run manifest
candidate_set_comparison: full Nudox capability score plus paired ranker scores restricted to exact indexed_document_ids emitted by the upstream indexer
undefined_metrics: null per query when the denominator or ideal gain is undefined; omitted from each macro mean with defined-query counts reported
